g.text: T = 7 s + 0.75 s shared phase ramp | black dotted curves: each run reference
Corrected magnetic frames and unit servo DC gain; no-delay SITL; direct motor/servo commands.
Identical outer-loop gains and limits. One run per condition; no confidence intervals or smoothing.
Gray bands: peak holds (attitude task) or post-maneuver settling (Lissajous).
